title: Diagnostic Report: Chedraui (Grupo Comercial Chedraui)
summary: Chedraui.com.mx is a massive VTEX IO grocery e-commerce with 67 product sitemaps and approximately 5M monthly visits. The site faces severe mobile performance issues (Lighthouse 7-26/100), has no customer reviews, no Product JSON-LD structured data detected, and an underutilized /recetas editorial section. Strong brand search dominance (#1 for brand keyword) contrasts with significant technical debt across a catalog of tens of thousands of products.
